universities.name: University of Rijeka Faculty of Medicine
universities.summary: University of Rijeka Faculty of Medicine delivers a full-time, six-year Medical Studies in English programme in Rijeka. The integrated 360-ECTS route awards Doctor of Medicine and uses a 2026/27 admission call with a published entrance examination, annual tuition and winter-semester entry.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Faculty's English medicine programme is based at Braće Branchetta 20 in Rijeka. The current curriculum includes medical English courses, clinical-skills teaching, simulation of clinical skills and a final graduation examination and thesis, rather than a generic pre-medical foundation year.
universities.cityProfile: Rijeka is the programme location for the integrated medical degree. The official 2026/27 call requires the on-site hybrid entrance examination at the Faculty while also allowing simultaneous examination abroad; the academic year begins in October and admission is only to the winter semester.
universities.practicalExposure: The curriculum progresses from biomedical sciences to clinical subjects. Clinical Propedeutics appears in the third year, while later compulsory work includes surgery, anaesthesiology and intensive care, gynaecology and obstetrics, family medicine, clinical assessment, simulation of clinical skills and emergency medical conditions. The final programme requirements include a graduation examination and thesis.
universities.hostelOverview: No current Medical Studies in English housing offer or official price was verified in the admission and programme sources reviewed. Accommodation is not presented as included in the EUR 12,000 annual tuition figure.
universities.dietarySupport: No faculty-supported meal plan or food-cost schedule was verified for Medical Studies in English. Food and daily living remain separate budget items rather than stated programme benefits.
universities.safetyOverview: No current faculty-specific safety statistic was found in the reviewed sources. The programme record therefore does not make a general Rijeka safety claim.
universities.studentSupport: The Faculty's English medicine call identifies its Office of International Relations and Medical Studies in English for detailed programme and enrolment information. The application path also uses the national Central Admission Office for record verification and recognition of foreign secondary qualifications.
whyChoose: Six-year, 360-ECTS public-university medical programme leading to Doctor of Medicine.
2026/27 tuition is published at EUR 12,000 annually, with a EUR 200 entrance-exam application fee.
The current call sets out a concrete Biology, Chemistry and Physics entrance-examination process.
Clinical skills, propedeutics, simulation, clinical subjects and a graduation thesis are documented in the curriculum.
thingsToConsider: The 2026/27 autumn entrance exam is only held if places remain, and the documented deadline is 29 August 2026.
The first-year tuition must be paid in full at enrolment; the enrolment fee is only approximately stated at EUR 55.50.
Applicants must have studied Biology, Chemistry and Physics or related subjects for at least two years in secondary school.
Foreign secondary qualifications can require Central Admission Office recognition, with a published 1 July 2026 submission cut-off for the 2026 cycle.
No current accommodation or full living-cost schedule was verified in this packet.
bestFitFor: Secondary-school graduates with at least two years of Biology, Chemistry and Physics or related study.
Applicants prepared for an entrance examination and the required two-track Faculty and national-admission process.
Students who can budget separately for accommodation and living costs beyond the stated tuition.

faq.question: How long is Medical Studies in English at Rijeka?
faq.answer: It is a six-year full-time integrated university medicine programme carrying 360 ECTS and awarding Doctor of Medicine.

faq.question: What is the 2026/27 tuition?
faq.answer: The official call lists EUR 12,000 per academic year, or EUR 200 per ECTS. It separately lists a EUR 200 entrance-exam application fee and an enrolment fee expected to be about EUR 55.50.

faq.question: What school preparation is required?
faq.answer: Applicants need completed secondary school and final graduation examination, with Biology, Chemistry and Physics or related subjects studied for at least two years.

faq.question: Is there an entrance examination?
faq.answer: Yes. The 2026/27 call lists Biology, Chemistry and Physics entrance-exam terms and an intensive preparatory course before each term.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit documents through the Faculty web application, then send originals by express post after verification. Applicants also register through Croatia's Postani student Central Admission Office process.

faq.question: When is the intake?
faq.answer: The academic year starts in October and admission is only for the winter semester. The 2026 autumn exam is 4 September if places remain.

faq.question: What does the clinical curriculum include?
faq.answer: Published later-year compulsory subjects include surgery, anaesthesiology and intensive care, family medicine, gynaecology and obstetrics, clinical assessment, simulation and emergency medical conditions.

faq.question: Is housing included?
faq.answer: No Medical Studies in English housing offer or price was verified in the cited admission and programme material, so accommodation needs a separate budget.
